def get_divisors(n):
    divs = set()
    for i in range(1, int(math.sqrt(n)) + 1):
        if n % i == 0:
            divs.add(i)
            divs.add(n // i)
    return sorted(list(divs))

def tau(n):
    return len(get_divisors(n))

def solve_task():

    N_limit = 1000
    
    for n in range(1, N_limit + 1):
        divisors = get_divisors(n)
        num_divisors = len(divisors)

        # 2. Identify a, b, c

    return results
